title: Bouqueting Flowers: Workbench
body:
This datapack/mod allows the crafting of bouquets from flowers!
<hr>

You can craft them with three of the same flower, one paper, and one string in a crafting table (see gallery for an example of the recipe)

There are also mixed tulip bouquets with three of any color tulip together! Simply put the tulip colors in the order you want them to be in the bouquet in the recipe and voila! (see gallery for example).
<hr>

It's perfect for gifts to friends or as decoration :)
<hr>

An important note is that the change only applies to the item texture, and not what it looks like when it's placed. Also, if placed, it will not be a bouquet again if picked back up.
<hr>

If you're using the datapack, make sure you download the mandatory resource pack along with the datapack and add them both to your game!

If you're using the mod on singleplayer or client-side, the resource pack is built-in. If you're using the mod on a server, you will need to add the resource pack to the server, or everyone on the server will need to download the resource pack, or everyone will need the mod client-side, so that the textures load.
<hr>

There is also an [alternate version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bouqueting-flowers-anvil) that is only a resource pack where you rename a flower in an anvil to get the bouquet instead!
